svg.aria-label: Retry Budget Allocator. Three tries. Spend them on purpose. In plain words: When an automatic payment like a subscription fails, the rules allow only three more tries. A fixed schedule wastes them on accounts that can never pay. This system first asks why the payment failed, then decides: wait for payday, ask the customer, or stop. Half the tries, and no rule broken. Under the hood: Deterministic cause classifier over Razorpay error payloads, probabilistic funding-window inference with a safe-spacing fallback, compliance invariants enforced by an AST test and mutation testing (31 of 32 mutants killed). 70 vs 141 attempts, 0 wasted, and it publishes where it loses: 30 vs 35 recoveries.
